name: Plans権限とグループ割当の一覧表
prompt:
Create a polished, wide Japanese-product-style admin interface image based closely on the supplied Jira reference crop. Keep the composition panoramic and information-dense while still legible. Show the heading “Plans Global Permissions” at top left with one small slanted title marker using only the official Lighthouse gradient at 135 degrees (#174C36 0%, #1F6444 58%, #2D8F5E 100%). At top right show a white search field with a neutral slate magnifier and the exact text “Search Jira admin”. Below the heading show the exact explanatory sentence: “Jira Administrators can manage all global permissions for Plans. View and change available permissions and the user groups assigned to them in the below list.” Then a 3-column table with headers “Permission”, “Description”, “Groups” and exactly four rows:
1) “Plans Administrator” | “Ability to perform all administrative functions in plans. Jira Administrators are automatically Plans Administrators.” | chips “atlassian-addons-admin” and “confluence-admins-samleemobbin”
2) “Plans User” | “Ability to create, view and edit plans.” | chips “org-admins”, “jira-users-samleemobbin”, and “jira-admins-samleemobbin”
3) “Plans Viewer” | “Ability to browse and view plans in read-only mode.” | a simple “Add” action
4) “Labs Access” | “Ability to access and use features that are in LABS mode.” | a simple “Add” action.
Preserve this content and row order exactly. Use white surfaces throughout, ink #1D1D1D, secondary text #6E6E6E, neutral slate icons #526173, thin light-neutral row dividers, and white group chips with subtle neutral borders. Keep the official gradient confined to the small heading marker. No tint colors, tinted panels, washes, glow, saturated extra colors, invented values, or extra rows. Do not add navigation around the component.
reviewNotes: Reviewed v1 against the saved Plans Global Permissions crop. Preserves the title, explanatory sentence, all four permission names/descriptions, exact group chips and Add actions in row order. White surfaces, neutral slate controls, and the official gradient only in the small title marker; no tinted areas. Static candidate review only; no application behavior or editable implementation claimed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
